name: Krushclub
summary: The TikTok-viral 2023–24 microgenre that fuses the Jersey Club 5-kick bounce with HexD's bitcrushed distortion and hyperpop's pitched-up vocal chops. Krushclub keeps Jersey Club's syncopated kick shape (or, in its house-leaning tracks, a plain four-on-the-floor) but layers clipped 808 glides, bitcrushed percussion loops and huge clap/snare stacks on top, and alternates a halftime trap feel with the full Jersey bounce inside the same track.

sounds.kick: Layered Jersey Club kick (sub + punchy mid, sometimes a click layer) on the 5-kick shape (1, 2, 3, a-of-3, &-of-4), or four-on-the-floor for the house-leaning branch; hard-clipped and bitcrushed harder than plain Jersey Club.
sounds.snare: Huge stacked clap+snare hit on 2 and 4 (both roles fired together), pitched and distorted hyperpop-style; halftime tracks move the backbeat to beat 3 alone.
sounds.hats: Bitcrushed closed hats kept low under the kick shape, with trap/hyperpop-style accelerating hi-hat rolls into backbeats and hooks; open hat on Jersey-style pickups.
sounds.percussion: The bed-squeak sample (from Trillville's 'Some Cut') carried in the clave slot as a call-and-response hook; bitcrushed cowbell/tomLow/perc loops for the HexD-lead sections; clipped 808 glide as a low tomLow pulse.
sounds.cymbals: One crash on drop impacts only; otherwise absent — krushclub doesn't use a ride or cymbal wash.

machines: Akai MPC60 / MPC3000 — sample and swing the Jersey kick/squeak/clap chain 12-bit style
Roland TR-808 — clap and snare layers, pitched-down snare option, 808 sub glide
Roland TR-909 — closed/open hat layer under bitcrush processing
E-mu SP-1200 — 12-bit resampling stage for the bitcrushed percussion loop
Akai S900 — 12-bit sampler stand-in for crushing the bed-squeak and vocal chops
Elektron Machinedrum / Korg Electribe ER-1 — synthesised metallic/bitcrushed percussion loops
Roland TR-727 / TR-505 — congas/claves for the cumbia/funk-mandelão fusion groove
iZotope / Decimort-style bitcrusher plugins — the genre-defining lo-fi distortion stage
Sonic Academy Kick 2 or similar — modern synthesised 808/kick layer producers design from scratch
